topics.name: Photosynthesis
subtopics: Plants make their own food (glucose) by photosynthesis, mainly in the leaves, using sunlight, carbon dioxide and water
Plants change some glucose into starch stored in leaves, stems, roots, flowers, fruits and seeds
Plants give off oxygen used by animals and people for breathing; animals give out carbon dioxide used by plants

topics.name: Nutrients in food
subtopics: Food groups and main nutrients: carbohydrates (energy), proteins (growth and repair), fats and oils (energy storage, insulation), vitamins and minerals
Most natural foods contain more than one nutrient group
Processed foods have added salt, sugar, preservatives, flavourings and colourings

topics.name: Nutrition
subtopics: A diet is the selection of foods we eat every day
A balanced diet contains all four nutrient groups, water and fibre
Some diseases can be related to diet

topics.name: Ecosystems and food webs
subtopics: An ecosystem is an area where living and non-living things depend on each other; examples include rivers, sea, wetlands, grasslands, forests and deserts
Relationships between living things and non-living things (air, water, sunlight, soil) in an ecosystem
Food webs: producers, consumers (herbivores, carnivores, omnivores) and decomposers that return nutrients to the soil

topics.name: Solids, liquids and gases
subtopics: All matter is made up of particles
Particle arrangement and movement in solids, liquids and gases

topics.name: Mixtures
subtopics: A mixture consists of at least two different substances
Separating visible mixtures by sieving, filtering, hand sorting, settling and decanting

topics.name: Solutions as special mixtures
subtopics: Solutions are uniform mixtures made by dissolving a solid in a liquid (e.g. sugar or salt in water)
Soluble solids (solutes) dissolve in a solvent; solutes can be recovered by evaporation
Dissolving: solute particles disperse between solvent particles
Saturated solutions and insoluble substances

topics.name: Dissolving
subtopics: Factors that affect the rate of dissolving: temperature, stirring or shaking, and grain size of the solute

topics.name: Mixtures and water resources
subtopics: Water pollution by insoluble substances, soluble substances and germs causing water-borne illnesses
Wetlands remove substances from water and regulate water flow

topics.name: Processes to purify water
subtopics: A clean water supply is important for people, plants and animals
Water can be cleaned by sieving, filtering, settling, decanting, boiling and adding chemicals to kill germs
Municipal water is cleaned before and after use

terms.theme: Energy and Change & Systems and Control

topics.name: Electric circuits
subtopics: An electric circuit is a system for transferring energy
Circuit components: energy source (cell/battery), conducting wires and a device (bulb, buzzer, motor)
A circuit is a complete, unbroken pathway; a switch breaks or completes the circuit
Symbols used in circuit diagrams

topics.name: Electrical conductors and insulators
subtopics: Conductors: most metals, especially copper, conduct electricity
Insulators: most non-metals, such as plastics, do not conduct electricity

topics.name: Systems to solve problems
subtopics: Electric circuits solve problems such as street lighting, alarms, electric gates, traffic lights, fans and heaters
Electric circuits in models and toys

topics.name: Mains electricity
subtopics: Fossil fuels (coal, oil, natural gas) formed from dead plants and animals and are non-renewable
In a coal-fired power station, steam turns a turbine that turns a generator to produce electricity
Cost of electricity: infrastructure and appliance use; ways to save energy
Renewable ways to generate electricity

terms.theme: Planet Earth and Beyond & Systems and Control

topics.name: The Solar System
subtopics: The Sun is at the centre of our Solar System with eight planets and the asteroid belt in orbit
Each planet has its own features, size, orbit, position, composition (rocky or gas) and number of moons
Moons do not give out their own light; features of our Moon (craters, mountains, plains)

topics.name: Movements of the Earth and planets
subtopics: Rotation: each planet spins on its axis; Earth's rotation takes about 24 hours, causing day and night
Revolution: planets travel around the Sun; Earth's revolution takes 365¼ days (a year)

topics.name: The movement of the Moon
subtopics: The Moon rotates once in about 28 days
The Moon revolves around the Earth in about a month; together they revolve around the Sun

topics.name: Systems for looking into space
subtopics: Telescopes are used to look into space and gather information
South Africa has built and uses some of the largest telescopes

topics.name: Systems to explore the Moon and Mars
subtopics: People have explored the Moon's surface using a Moon Rover
Robotic Mars Rovers have explored the surface of Mars
